content.value_statement: Polish KSeF integration requires coordinated invoice mapping, authentication, and contingency planning. This written guide frames those tasks around FA(3), KSeF onboarding, and offline24 considerations.
actual_capabilities: Introduces KSeF integration topics, including invoice numbering, authentication, and contingency planning.
Identifies FA(3) mapping tasks for standard, correction, and advance invoices.
Provides one correction-invoice mapping example with named fields and original invoice references.
Identifies test, demo, and production environments as API onboarding considerations.
Highlights offline24 certificate, QR code, and submission-window considerations.
Notes restrictions on invoice attachments and the need to handle commercial PDFs separately.
limitations: The folder contains only SKILL.md; scripts, extension source, templates, and schema files are not included.
The brief guide does not provide a complete API client, XML validator, or QR code implementation.
Schema mappings, certificate requirements, and deadlines require verification against current official documentation.
The guide does not establish legal compliance or provide production credentials and certificates.

use_cases.title: Scope an ERP Mapping Project
use_cases.description: Identify invoice types, source fields, and unresolved FA(3) mapping questions before implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Onboarding Review
use_cases.description: Organize environment, authentication, and certificate questions for a KSeF integration review.

use_cases.title: Review Contingency Requirements
use_cases.description: List offline24 operational questions, attachment constraints, and official documentation needed for a finance workflow review.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the Integration Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the KSeF integration topics in this guide. Separate documented guidance from details requiring official verification.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Invoice Field Mapping
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these anonymized ERP fields: [fields]. Draft FA(3) mapping questions for [invoice type]. Mark unknown mappings and request the official schema.

prompt_templates.title: Outline API Onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an onboarding checklist for [environment] using the guide. Identify authentication decisions, certificate dependencies, and missing documentation. Do not request credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Offline24 Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this offline24 design: [design]. Flag certificate, QR code, submission, and recovery questions. Verify requirements against [official documentation] and label unsupported assumptions.

output_examples.input: What should we collect before mapping ERP invoices to FA(3)?
output: Identify the invoice types: standard, correction, or advance.
Inventory source fields using anonymized invoice examples.
Obtain the official FA(3) schema before accepting field mappings.
Record unresolved correction-reference and attachment requirements.

output_examples.input: Can this package implement our offline24 workflow?
output: The package provides written guidance, not an executable offline24 implementation.
Review certificate access, QR code requirements, submission windows, and recovery handling.
Confirm technical rules against current official documentation before implementation.
Plan separate implementation and testing for the missing integration components.

output_examples.input: How should we review a correction-invoice mapping?
output: The guide includes a correction example referencing the original invoice.
Treat its field names and values as proposals requiring official schema verification.
Validate the resulting document before using it in a production workflow.

best_practices: Verify all field values, legal dates, and certificate requirements against current official KSeF documentation.
Use anonymized invoice samples and keep private keys, tokens, and certificates outside prompts.
Validate mappings and recovery behavior in an appropriate test environment before production use.
anti_patterns: Treating the brief guide as a complete, validated KSeF implementation.
Copying example field values into production without checking the official FA(3) schema.
Assuming scripts, templates, update notifications, or production access are included in this folder.

faq.question: What does this skill include?
faq.answer: It includes one written guide covering KSeF integration topics and one correction-invoice example. Scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.

faq.question: Does it generate validated FA(3) invoices?
faq.answer: No validator or schema file is included. Any proposed mapping or XML output requires verification against the official FA(3) schema.

faq.question: Can it connect directly to KSeF?
faq.answer: No API client or connection tooling is included. The guide identifies onboarding and authentication topics for implementation planning.

faq.question: Does it implement offline24 QR codes?
faq.answer: It highlights offline24 certificate and QR code considerations, but includes no QR generator or executable contingency workflow.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this guide?
faq.answer: Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use the text as context. Actual implementation depends on the assistant environment and supplied documentation.

faq.question: Are its deadlines and compliance statements authoritative?
faq.answer: No. Verify legal requirements, dates, and technical details with current official sources and qualified advisers before relying on them.
